*Mastercard(R) Stay Three Nights, Save 35% Terms & Conditions: 

1. The Offer is only valid for Eligible Mastercard Cardholders.

2. Black-out dates apply, are unique to each Participating Property, and are subject to change.

3. Booking Change Rules
a. All changes are subject to availability.
b. All Changes need to be made at least 72 hours prior to check-in date4. Cancellation Policy

a. Complimentary cancellation 72 hours prior to Check-In Date

b. The full reservation amount will be charged for cancellations made within 72 hours of the check-in date

5. Offer is only valid at Participating Properties, and the general terms and conditions of bookings and stay
applicable to each individual Participating Property will apply.

6. Participating Properties are subject to change without notice. The number of rooms available under the
Offer at each Participating Property may be limited.

7. The Offer cannot be exchanged for cash or used in conjunction with other on-going promotions/offers,
coupons/vouchers.

8. This offer is valid for new reservations of a Qualifying Stay, made by an Eligible Mastercard Cardholder
and paid with an Eligible Mastercard Card, during the Booking Window for a stay at a Participating Property
within the Stay Window.

9. A "Qualifying Stay" means a booking at a Participating Property that meets all the following criteria:-

a. The stay is for three consecutive nights at a Participating Property;

b. The reservation must be made via phone or online using/quoting the rate code "1000039087" at
https://click.emails.wyndhamhotels.com/? or on the phone during the time of reservation;

c. The name of the cardholder used to make and pay for the reservation ("Cardholder") must be the same name of
the person checking-in at the property and must be the one staying at the property

d. Eligible Mastercard Cardholders are required to provide their Eligible Mastercard Card details when making
a room reservation, at the point of check-in and when settling room payment.

e. Room reservation can only be guaranteed by using an Eligible Mastercard Card. A no-show does not count as a
Qualifying Stay

10. "Book Window" means the period from 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2026 (Both Dates Inclusive).

11. "Stay Window" means the period from 1 January 2026 to 31 January 2027 (Both Dates Inclusive).

12. There is no limit to the number of Qualifying Stays an Eligible Mastercard Cardholder may make at a
Participating Property under the Offer, but consecutive Qualifying Stays at the same Participating Property
(i.e., where check-out and re-check-in occurs on the same day) shall be deemed as one Qualifying Stay for the
purposes of the Offer.

13. All payments part of the Qualifying Stay will need to be settled at the time of check-out using the same
Eligible Mastercard Card only.

14. The Standard Rate is a specific rate type for each Participating Properties that may vary, is unrestricted
and excludes discounted or negotiated rates not available to the general public.

15. Room rate does not include breakfast unless otherwise stated.

16. Free basic Wi-Fi access at Participating Properties is subject to availability. Participating Properties
without wireless internet may provide wired High-Speed Internet Access (HSIA).
Some Participating Properties may charge additional fees for internet speed faster than basic Wi-Fi access.17.
Early check-in at Participating Properties is subject to availability, upon Eligible Mastercard Cardholder's
request. Early check-in is determined by the Participating Property and is only applicable to the Eligible
Mastercard Cardholder's personal guest room. Early check-in requests should not be for a time that is more
than two hours prior to the Participating Property's standard check-in time.

18. Late check-out at Participating Properties is subject to availability, upon Cardholder's request. Late
check-out is determined by the Participating Properties and is only applicable to the Eligible Mastercard
Cardholder's personal guest room. Late check-out requests should not be for a time that is more than two hours
after the Participating Properties' standard check-out time.

19. Preferred Room Choice

a. Subject to Availability

b. Subject to Participating Properties confirmation on availability of rooms

c. Upon Cardholder's request and must be within the same Room Category (i.e. recently renovated rooms, room
with a desired view or location)

20. The Offer only applies to the room rate and does not apply to any additional or incidental non-room
expenses or other charges (such as taxes, service charges, food and beverage, minibar, room service, phone
charges) incurred or accrued during the Qualifying Stay. Extra person charges may apply if a room is to be
occupied more than two persons.

21. All stays under this Offer are eligible to earn Wyndham Rewards Points, however Wyndham Rewards Points
cannot be used to pay for the stay in conjunction with the Offer.

22. By making a reservation for a Qualifying Stay under the Offer, Cardholders agree and consent to these
terms and conditions. Fulfilment of the Offer at each Participating Property is the responsibility of such
Participating Property.

23. The Offer may not be used in conjunction with any other discounts, promotions, offers, packages, group or
convention rate, or any other discounted rate, and is not valid for previous stays or existing reservations at
the Participating Properties and cannot be redeemed or exchanged for cash or other products.

24. Eligible Mastercard Cardholders are required to provide their Eligible Mastercard Card details when making
the room reservation, at the point of check-in and when settling room payment. Room reservations can only be
guaranteed by using an Eligible Mastercard Card. A no-show does not count as a Qualifying Stay.

25. Wyndham Hotels & Resorts may cancel or modify the Offer without notice.

**Wyndham Travel Bundles 3X Points Terms & Conditions: 

Capitalized terms used without definition in these promotion terms and conditions ("Offer Terms") will have
the meanings ascribed to them in the Wyndham Rewards Program terms and conditions, available at
www.wyndhamhotels.com/wyndhamrewards/terms https://click.emails.wyndhamhotels.com/?
 (the "Program Terms").
_3X Wyndham Rewards Bonus Points:_
To qualify for 3X Wyndham Travel Bundle Wyndham Rewards bonus points , a Wyndham Rewards Member must, during
the period that begins March 18, 2026 and runs through and includes April 30, 2026 (the "Booking Period"),
book one (1) stay at a participating Wyndham Rewards hotel, together with at least one (1) flight or cruise on
https://click.emails.wyndhamhotels.com/? (the "Wyndham Travel Bundle Site") and complete such
booking in accordance with Section II(I)https://www.wyndhamhotels.com/en-ap/wyndham-rewards
of the Program Terms and the WTB Terms & Conditions
https://click.emails.wyndhamhotels.com/?
 by December 31, 2026 (a "3X Points Booking").
Except as otherwise set forth below with respect to earnings for Members who have elected to earn Travel
Partner Currency rather than Wyndham Rewards points in their Wyndham Rewards Member profile ("Miles Earners"),
each 3 Points Booking will earn 3X the amount of Wyndham Rewards points it would have earned pursuant to the
Program Terms (absent this offer). For example, a 3X Points Booking that would, under the Program Terms, earn
3,000 Base Points would, pursuant to this offer, earn a total of 9,000 points (3 X 3,000 = 9,000, with 3,000
of such points denominated as base earning, and the remaining 6,000 points denominated as bonus earning).
Miles Earners will receive their base earnings in accordance with the Program Terms (i.e., base earnings for
the hotel stay in Travel Partner Currency, and base earnings for all other Travel Components in points), and
their bonus earnings in points only. Bonus earnings will be in an amount equal to: two (2), multiplied by the
sum of: (i) the number of base miles (or other applicable Travel Partner Currency) earned for the hotel stay
plus (ii) the number of base points earned for all other Travel Components.
Bonus points will usually be posted to a Member's account within two to four weeks after the activity through
which they were earned. For clarity, a Member will not receive bonus points if they fail to complete any
Travel Component booked as part of their 3X Points Booking.
3X Points Bookings must be paid in full in advance and become non-cancelable and non-refundable 24 hours after
booking.
_Cruise Discount:_
To qualify for the applicable advertised discount on a cruise Travel Component (between 10% and 20% off of the
applicable cruise line's Standard Rate (as defined below) for Wyndham Rewards Members, and between 20% and 40%
off of the applicable cruise line's Standard Rate for Wyndham Rewards Insiders), a Wyndham Rewards Member
must, during the Booking Period, book a cruise with Carnival Cruise Line(R), Seabourn(R), Holland America(R)
or Princess(R) Cruises, together with a stay at a participating Wyndham Rewards hotel or a flight, on the
Wyndham Travel Bundle Site, and complete such booking in accordance with Section II(I)
https://click.emails.wyndhamhotels.com/?
 of the Program Terms and the WTB Terms & Conditions
https://click.emails.wyndhamhotels.com/?
 by December 31, 2026 (a "Cruise Discount Booking").
For purposes of these Offer Terms, "Standard Rate" means the best, unrestricted, publicly available rate that
is then available on the applicable cruise line's website for the same cruise, cabin class/inclusions package
and dates.
Cruise Discount Bookings must be paid in full in advance and become non-cancelable and non-refundable 24 hours
after booking.
Must be a Wyndham Rewards Member in good standing to qualify for discount and the 3X bonus points. Offer
availability is limited to participating Wyndham Rewards hotels, cruise lines and airlines and subject to
blackout dates. Not all Wyndham Rewards hotels offer reservations through the Travel Bundle Site at all times,
and some do not offer reservations through the Travel Bundle Site at any time.
Blackout dates, room/cabin/fare type exclusions and other restrictions may apply and vary by individual hotel,
airline and cruise line. For the avoidance of doubt, any modification made to a reservation made pursuant to
these Offer Terms may result in an ineligibility to receive the advertised bonus points and/or discount.
Individuals who are not yet Wyndham Rewards Members will need to enroll in the Wyndham Rewards Program to
receive the benefits described above; to void enrollment, call Wyndham Rewards member services at
1-866-996-7937. For clarity, the Bonus is not available to anyone who is not a Member at the time of its
scheduled award, and the cruise discount is not available to anyone who is not a Member at the time of
booking. For more general information on the Wyndham Rewards Program, including details on free enrollment,
please visit www.wyndhamhotels.com/wyndham-rewards https://click.emails.wyndhamhotels.com/?
Offer is combinable ONLY with applicable registration-based, bonus point promotions; it may not be combined
with any other offer, discount, coupon, sale promotion, prior purchase, group bookings or purchase of a gift
certificate. Rates do not include resort/service fees, taxes, incidentals or gratuities or additional per
room, per night charges that may be imposed. Rate, taxes and applicable dates may vary by hotel, airline
and/or cruise line; please inquire at time of reservation.
This offer and its terms and conditions are subject to cancellation or change at any time and void where
prohibited.
